text_block_list.text: Passing through hallway on heavily raining day――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...C-Cafe-san, I'm sorry. Um,
Rice brought bad luck on you, didn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...If Rice hadn't asked to run together,
heavy rain wouldn't have kept us from running...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............?
...Um, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for... not hearing.
I was... concentrating...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...On drawing a picture.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh...? A picture?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Spell creating world on windowpane.
Fun thing... only possible on rainy days.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...But this world is over.
Unable to find happiness... remaining hollow.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Because black cat's beloved friend
is missing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Black cat is... all alone. Unsaved by anyone,
unable to convey feelings... slowly drying away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eh...? T-That's... so sad...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I failed to draw... calico cat,
black cat's friend.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Then Rice will draw it instead!
Rice can draw a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, since it's calico cat...
Draw coat pattern, whiskers, and tail...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............! ...Um,
calico cat friend has swirl tail.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, matching with black cat here...! 
Fufu. They really are best friends...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Found ya, Cafe-san!
Dorm head said head back early 'cause heavy rain...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well my, my! What mighty cute drawin'!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I find it cute too. Happy... wonderful world
drawn by Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh. B-But Rice only drew
calico cat...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because you drew calico cat,
black cat... looks happy now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I am happy too.
Able to draw together, thanks to heavy rain.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to... heavy rain.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well then... Yukino-san is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Let's get back to room
'fore dorm head gets mad~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you!
Um, even though Rice caused heavy rain...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to Cafe-san, it was fun.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It was fun for me too...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, next time...
I can explain how to draw calico cat.

Cherishing her own world no matter what,
Manhattan Cafe seemed to create
peaceful moment amidst pouring rain.
